titles.english: A Little Snow Fairy Sugar OVA
titles.native: ちっちゃな雪使いシュガー特別編

description:
Four years have passed since Saga and Sugar had their adventures, Saga’s grandmother finds an old dress and recalls Saga’s school play. With priceless memories of Saga and the faeries trying out for the school play, we get to see a little glimpse of where Saga is now.

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)
